source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: Share-page text whose speaker lines hold one short word that the next line begins a longer word with: 'No' before 'Nothing', 'Yes' before 'Yesterday'.

Apple discards the text after the header whenever more text follows: 'No' and 'Yes' are lost. The web app takes such text for a preview only when the next line begins with it and, no ellipsis having been cut, the text ends where a word ends. 'Nothing' continues 'No' with a letter, so 'No' is kept as the first line of the turn.
